claims: Santa Clara is a city in Santa Clara County, California.
Santa Clara is located in the heart of Silicon Valley.
Santa Clara is situated about 45 miles south of San Francisco.
Santa Clara is known as the home of Levi's Stadium.
Santa Clara is known as the home of Intel.
Santa Clara is known as the home of Nvidia.
Santa Clara is known as the home of Santa Clara University.
Santa Clara is in the San Francisco Bay Area (South Bay).
Santa Clara is situated in the Santa Clara Valley.
Santa Clara is situated along the Guadalupe River.
Santa Clara is often called "The Mission City".
